title: HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Sensor
description: Use HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor to measure distances and create obstacle detection systems.

warnings: HC-SR04 requires 5V power supply (use VBUS pin)
Don't connect ECHO directly if using level converters

theory.ultrasonic: Ultrasonic sensors emit high-frequency sound waves (40kHz) and measure time taken to return after reflecting on an object. Distance = (time × speed of sound) / 2.
theory.hcsr04: HC-SR04 has range of 2cm to 4m with 3mm precision. Works by sending 10µs pulse on TRIG pin and measuring HIGH pulse duration on ECHO pin.
theory.soundspeed: Speed of sound in air is ~343 m/s (at 20°C). In microseconds: distance_cm = duration_µs / 58.

steps.title: Connect the Sensor
steps.description: Assemble circuit with HC-SR04 and LEDs
details: Connect HC-SR04 according to wiring diagram

steps.title: Configure Sensor in BIPES
details: Configure TRIG on GPIO 16 and ECHO on GPIO 17

steps.title: Implement Alert System
details: If distance < 10cm: red LED on, green off
If distance >= 10cm: green LED on, red off
Test by approaching objects to sensor

bipesProject.description: BIPES project with HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor configured. Includes distance reading and visual alert system.

troubleshooting.problem: Sensor always returns 0 or inconsistent values
solutions: Check if TRIG and ECHO are on correct pins
Make sure no objects are too close (<2cm)
Check if GND is well connected
Add delay of at least 60ms between readings
Avoid very angled or sound-absorbing surfaces
Calculate average of 3-5 readings for stability
Check if object isn't too small or absorbent
Test with large flat surface (wall, book)
Test LEDs individually with Digital Write
Check if distance thresholds are adequate
